messages:
sarah_sales: Heads up — running through ACME POC demo this morning and saw repeated 429s when we hit ~10 concurrent requests. Demo depends on parallel calls so this blocks the live walkthrough.
sarah_sales: Sample curl I sent to customer:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"hello"}'
```
sarah_sales: Response headers show `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 15`. Can someone confirm which quota this is hitting (per-tenant vs per-route vs global)?
aj_devex: pinging SRE + runtime, will gather logs and ask sales to share tenant id + route. @sarah_sales can you drop tenant id + route name?
sarah_sales: tenant=acme-trial-09 route=demo/generate
carlos_sre: looking at infra logs now. I see per-route enforcement hits — the rate limiter reports the route's token budget was exceeded. Sample from limiter:
```text
[rate_limiter] ts=2167891201 route=demo/generate cap=1000 window=60s used=1024
```
carlos_sre: So this is the per-route token cap (not the global tenant cap). Behavior: bursts over the cap return 429 until the window slides. We can do a short-term bump for the demo. Need sales ops approval to change route config.
mira_engineer: also check client concurrency pattern. If they fire 10 streams simultaneously the KV cache warm-up increases token usage. Two quick mitigations: set client concurrency to 4 and add exponential retry (jitter). Also enabling prefix caching reduces repeat token spend.
aj_devex: Sarah — propose two options to ACME: 1) temporary per-route cap bump for 1 hour (fast, demo-safe); 2) client change: lower concurrency + backoff (no infra change). Also note pricing impact for option 1 — will bill extra tokens. Which do they prefer?
sarah_sales: customer prefers option 1 for the live demo. They're OK with paying for demo tokens. Also they're pressing on the security questionnaire: Q12 about token retention and logs. Any short statement we can give them now?
mira_engineer: security note: hosted trials default to ephemeral KV caching and 30-day logs retention; for POCs we can shorten retention and disable persistent KV. Draft line: "Logs retained for 7 days by default for POCs; KV caching is ephemeral and not persisted to customer storage unless requested." I can paste a formal blurb.
carlos_sre: I've applied a temporary bump: per-route cap set to 2000 tokens/window until ts=2167894834 (1 hour). Also added fallback routing to a compatible smaller model if the route saturates. Please re-run the demo and paste any failing response.
sarah_sales: re-tested with ACME — no 429s during the walkthrough. Demo passed, they asked for follow-up on long-term pricing for sustained throughput. Customer happy :tada:
aj_devex: I'll follow up with billing to propose sustained capacity options (Dedicated) and update the POC ticket with the config change and the security blurb. Closing thread unless anyone needs more here.
mira_engineer: FYI I've started a draft answer for their security questionnaire and will attach it to the ticket.
